entries.content: Let me explore the codebase to understand the project structure and find the relevant files for the product card and wishlist button.

Now I have a complete understanding of the issue. Let me create the implementation plan.

**Summary of the issue:**
- In `assets/css/components/_product-card.css`, the `.product-card-wishlistBtn` has `opacity: 0` and `transform: scale(0.8)` by default
- It only becomes visible on `.product-card:hover` (which doesn't work on touch devices) or when `.is-active` (item is in wishlist)
- Touch devices can't trigger hover, so users can never see or interact with the button

**Solution:**
Add a CSS media query using `@media (hover: none)` to always show the wishlist button on touch devices.

## ✅ Subtask 1.1 Completed Successfully

I've successfully implemented the media query to make the wishlist button always visible on touch devices.

### What Was Done:

**Implementation:**
- Added `@media (hover: none)` media query to `assets/css/components/_product-card.css`
- Inside the media query, set `.product-card-wishlistBtn` to:
  - `opacity: 1` (making it visible)
  - `transform: scale(1)` (full size)
- Placed the media query after existing hover rules for proper CSS cascade
- Added clear comment explaining the purpose

```css
/* Touch device support - make wishlist button always visible on touch devices */
@media (hover: none) {
    .product-card-wishlistBtn {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
    }
}
```
